goal: Reduce FALSE_BREAKOUT (losing positions, MFE < 0.3R) and CHOP (losing, MFE 0.3R..1R) losses of the DEPLOYED bot without cutting the winners.
bench: high_cagr/r3_harness.py (frozen). Baseline = deployed bot (4B + V2 + BTC gate, 2.0 ATR, R 0.75%, 4 slots) run separately on OLD5 / NEW10 / HOLD10. Baseline full@2bps Calmar 1.420 / 0.956 / 0.283.
pass_gate (all): full@2 Calmar not worse than baseline-0.02 on EACH universe
DD not worse by > 1pt on each universe
mean Calmar not worse in H1 and in H2
mean Calmar of the two untouched universes (NEW10, HOLD10) >= baseline + 0.03
causal (truncation check) and, for a custom kernel, bit-identical parity with switches off
multiple_testing: Each agent: max 2 batches of <= 4 variants, every variant ever run stays in the JSON. A pass from batch 2 counts only if a neighbouring parameter value also passes or is within 0.03 Calmar.
confirmation: Any pass must then be confirmed on a FRESH holdout of 10 symbols never touched (next by Sep-2021 liquidity, funding complete), declared before download.
passed_before_but_not_deployed: initial stop 2.5 ATR (passes on 15 symbols/6 slots, fails on 5/4)

agents.A1_entry_mechanics: FB: how/where we enter: retest/limit entry after breakout, entry buffer beyond level, stop anchored to breakout structure, delayed entry on the next bar's open only if still beyond level
agents.A2_positioning: FB: crowding/positioning from FUNDING rates (available per symbol, minute grid) and relative strength vs BTC
agents.A3_timing: FB: calendar/session/bar-timing effects (weekend, UTC hour of the 4h bar, time since last signal on the symbol, number of recent failed breakouts on the same symbol)
agents.A4_adaptive_risk: CHOP: don't filter, SIZE: per-symbol / portfolio risk scaled by recent strategy outcomes or regime, re-entry cooldown after a stop-out
agents.A5_regime_statistics: CHOP: statistical trendiness measures not yet tried: Hurst / variance ratio / return autocorrelation / realized-vol regime / R-squared of linear fit
agents.A6_loss_anatomy: BOTH: data-mining discriminators between FB/CHOP losers and winners at entry time; discovery ONLY on OLD5+NEW10 H1 trades, then pre-declare 1-2 rules and test on the bench

meeting: After batch 1 every agent receives all results, critiques the others and proposes at most one follow-up (batch 2). The strategy lead (main session) decides which follow-ups run and writes the synthesis.
decision: Results only; no bot change without the user's confirmation.
